Definition: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
BiblicalUsage: If ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins, and out of heaven He made thee to hear His voice, that He might instruct thee. Rehoboam said, my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions, and Chenaniah instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that chastising and instructing are one work in God's hands: He punishes to correct, He speaks from heaven to instruct, and even Chenaniah's teaching of the song is the same word. I believe discipline is never only pain — it is God teaching His people what He will not leave untaught.
